text: Surrounded by the glass walls of a modern meeting or lecture room, I observe the order and symmetry of the space. There is a feeling of anticipation and possibility, yet also a stark quietness. Moving into the vibrant exhibit area, words like 'R+D' and statements about rapid development confront me with thoughts on innovation and the nature of research. Here, I feel energized, as if on the threshold of discovery, but I am also aware of how easily these spaces can turn creativity into a kind of spectacle. I am both inspired and wary, sensing that knowledge here is both cultivated and curated.
